scope: Independent visualization of frozen Settings first100M scheduler credits, A then B. Actual emu_frame pixels at observed wall-clock pace. NOT ABBA measurement, browser latency or Mac performance.
method: Same frozen inputs and1M scheduler-credit chunks. Frame capture, PNG encoding and recording I/O overhead remain in displayed elapsed pace. Each arm starts after restore/engine setup; setup and the gap between arms are outside the recording. After100M, the actual stopped framebuffer is held for one measured second. Millisecond video timestamp quantization; no interpolation or speed change.

media.encoding: Sequential variable-frame-rate H264 with B frames disabled; no frame interpolation, all source frames retained, millisecond acquisition timestamp quantization. YUV420 lossy encoding is not pixel-identical; raw PNGs and decoded source hashes retained.
